title: Kereta dipandu tekong terbabas, 9 PATI ditahan
summary: Tumpat: Cubaan seorang tekong darat menyeludup sembilan pendatang asing tanpa izin (PATI) warga Myanmar gagal selepas kereta dinaiki terbabas ketika cuba melarikan diri daripada polis di Jalan Tali Air Kampung Neting, di sini, semalam.

title_en: Car driven by tekong crashes, nine PATIs arrested
summary_en: Tumpat: An attempt by a land rover to smuggle nine illegal foreign immigrants (PATI) from Myanmar failed after the car they were in crashed while trying to escape police on Tali Air Jalan Kampung Neting, here yesterday.
